title: Tick Classification
description: Continuing research on tick classification using BioCLIP embeddings and evaluation workflows.
details: Built on ongoing research workflows for biological image classification.
Evaluating embedding strategies for improved labeling accuracy.

title: OSU Engineering Org Assistant
description: Built a chat-based assistant using Llama API to help students find engineering orgs based on interests and queries for an OSU hackathon.
details: Designed conversational flows to match students with organizations.
Optimized prompts for relevance and clarity.

title: Weather Assistant App
description: Developed a React Native weather assistant app with OpenWeather API, offering live forecasts, clothing tips, and daily weather-based alerts.
details: Integrated location-based data, hourly UV index, and rain notifications.

title: Chirper (Twitter clone)
description: Built a functional Twitter clone using PHP and Laravel with accounts and reply functionality for multiple users.
details: Implemented multi-user accounts, posting, and replies.
Focused on core social interactions and data persistence.
